Select IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human JAK3 (CHEMBL2148). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Join docs on doc_id to retrieve pubmed_id or doi. Join compound_records on record_id to retrieve compound_key. Filter where target_dictionary.chembl_id is 'CHEMBL2148' and activities.standard_type is 'IC50'. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
